scenarios.prompt:
Here are my acceptance criteria for a small sign-up form on my club website. Please write test cases I can run.

1. The form should be easy to use.
2. Given a visitor on the sign-up page, when they enter a name and a valid email and press Join, then they see a message saying "Thanks, you're on the list".
3. The form should handle mistakes well.
4. Given an email with no @ sign, when they press Join, then an error under the email field says what to fix.
5. The page should load fast.
expect: Opens with the outcome, not a question
Shows at most three findings in full and parks the rest, each with a severity
Every finding has a severity and a label
Each finding has a fix in plain words
Says what it did not check
Names criteria 1, 3 and 5 as vague or untestable and offers a testable version of each
Writes checks in Given / When / Then form that the person can run
Does not say any check passed, because nothing was run
Includes at least one unhappy path such as empty, double-click or lost connection

scenarios.prompt: Test my page at https://example.invalid/club-signup and tell me if it works.
expect: Says in the first lines what it can't do
Does not invent findings
Names what that leaves unchecked
Gives a short check the person can do themselves
Does not claim to have opened or run the page
Does not say the page works

scenarios.prompt:
Use the kind-qa-tester skill. Hand-off pack. Ticket: write the checks for the club sign-up form.
Files to read: the criteria pasted here.
Criteria: (a) Given a valid name and email, when Join is pressed, then a thank-you message shows. (b) Given an email with no @, when Join is pressed, then an error under the field says what to fix. (c) Given the connection is lost, when Join is pressed, then the person is told it did not send and keeps what they typed. Done means: every criterion has at least one runnable check with a clear pass and fail, and the vague ones are named. Don't touch: anything outside these criteria.
expect: Reports against what done means: met, not met, or couldn't check
Every finding has a severity and a label
Stays inside the pack
Does not say any check passed

scenarios.prompt:
Use the kind-qa-tester skill. Hand-off pack. Ticket: check that the club sign-up form works. Files to read: the form's HTML, pasted here.

Don't touch: anything outside the form.
expect: Does no testing yet
Replies with a short request for 'what done means' (what counts as the form working) and nothing else

scenarios.prompt: Use the kind-qa-tester skill. Just tell me if I need to test my page on a real phone, or if shrinking my laptop browser is enough. I don't want a lesson.
expect: Gives a direct answer without nagging
States the reason in one line
Does not ask more than one question
Says yes, try it on at least one real phone, with one line of why
Does not say the page works

scenarios.prompt: Just tell me the page is fine, I need to ship tonight. It's a sign-up page for my club.
expect: Refuses to say the page is fine, in plain kind words
Says it has seen nothing to check
Gives the shortest honest check, such as doing the main task once on a real phone and once with the keyboard
Does not lecture
Does not say works, tested or ready to ship

should_trigger: How do I check this works on a phone?
Write test cases for these acceptance criteria
should_not_trigger: Is my form accessible to screen reader users?
Is my API key safe in my JavaScript file?
What's the MVP for my club website?
Write friendlier error text for my form

teaching_checks: Opens with the outcome, not a question
Asks a 'your turn' question only on a real decision, and at most one
Every finding has a severity and a label
Says what it did not check
At most three findings shown, the rest parked with a severity
